leverage.exposure: You are carrying a negative balance, which is the one condition that scores you zero for an entire matchday if it is still open when the whistle goes. It is not urgent — the lock is more than nine days out, and a deficit costs nothing at all until that instant. It is fully covered: the standing Treu sale clears it on its own with room to spare, and the Neuhaus flip, if it wins, stays comfortably inside what can be unwound even on a bad tick. The thing to watch is not the size of the deficit but the calendar. No live offer of yours is outstanding. Finally, a process note: the direct ledger database was not reachable this run, so the usual cross-check query could not be run. It did not cost anything, because the context block now lists every actionable call in full and states exactly what it is hiding, and everything hidden was of the non-actionable kinds — the old defect where sales could go invisible appears to be fixed. Sixteen factually dead calls were closed to stop the display filling up again.

binding_gap: The gap is not a position you cannot fill — it is a slot you have left empty. You own enough bodies for a legal eleven; you simply have not placed them. Once that is fixed the real structural hole appears one step later: the Treu sale that clears your deficit forces Nakuzola into the back four, and he is a large step down from the man he replaces. That is the hole a cheap defender would fill, and the board has nobody who fits it.

verdict.headline: Do one thing right now and it is free: your starting eleven is short a man.
verdict.headline_short: Do one thing right now and it is free: your starting eleven is short a
verdict.detail: Do one thing right now and it is free: your starting eleven is short a man. Engelhardt, the midfielder you bought at 03:38 this morning, was never placed, and Nakuzola is unplaced too — so only ten of your twelve are in the XI. An incomplete eleven takes the penalty at the lock. Dropping Engelhardt into midfield turns the shape into a 4-4-2, fills the eleventh slot and is the single biggest points swing available this run, at zero cost and with no transaction. Ligainsider's Freiburg projection, updated 21.09.2026, has him starting at home to Schalke on 11.10, so this is a projected starter you are leaving on the bench. Everything else on the board is noise: there is no points buy that survives the unwind test, and the only genuine opportunity is a value flip that expires around midday.

sell.reason: Treu remains the correct second leg of the unwind and the call stays open, but the timing matters more than the decision. He is flagged rising, and the measured next-tick behaviour of a rising player is strongly positive, so holding him through tonight's twenty-hundred update is worth real money for no points cost at all — the matchday does not lock for another nine days, which is what makes selling points-free right now. Sell him after tonight's tick, not before. On fitness he is fine and that is deliberately not the reason to sell: Ligainsider's 04.09.2026 item has him in an open contest with Kübler for the right-back slot, and Freiburg's projection still starts him, at left-back. He is being sold because he is the weakest fielded body you own and the cheapest way to clear the deficit, not because anything is wrong with him. Note the date trap here — the Treu cramping item is from April 2026 and is last season; it was not used. No other sale is warranted, and selling anyone above him costs more points than it saves.

He is mvt 1, and the measured next-tick drift for mvt 1 is n=613, mean +2,42%, 86,8% rose, so holding him through tonight's 20:00Z tick is worth ~+310.000 for zero points cost — the lock is 2026-10-09T18:30Z, 225,7h away, and selling is points-free during the break (Hfbknqv). CONTRAST WITH MATSIMA (Sci4bmv), WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE CASE AND MUST GO TODAY: Matsima is mvt 2, tfhmvt -360.118, sdmvt -1.553.659, and mvt 2 measures mean -3,52% at the next tick, so every tick he is held costs ~520.000. SELL MATSIMA BEFORE 20:00Z, HOLD TREU PAST IT. Joint arithmetic: 14.763.165 + 12.818.870 = 27.582.035 against cash -25.557.083, leaving surplus 2.024.952 and squad 11 (1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT = 4-4-2, every man fielded), which is exactly the W419xhq cheap-buy envelope and independently confirms it.

buy.reason: There is no points buy this run, and that conclusion is now derived rather than assumed. What binds is not your spending power, which is ample, but the unwind: with twelve players you may sell exactly two and still hold eleven, and the two you would actually sell cap what you can spend at a low figure. Anything above that ceiling cannot be unwound to a non-negative balance before the lock. Inside the ceiling the board is empty — the only defenders cheap enough either fall short of the man they would replace, have no scoring appearance at all, or carry a status flag. Three new names were killed explicitly so no later run re-derives them. Tah is the tempting one: a high-scoring Bayern defender listed by the market at exactly his value, and he misses the unwind test by a margin that is not close, while his falling flag kills him as a flip too. Scheller does pass an unwind, which is why he is worth naming, but the points arithmetic nets out to almost nothing once you count what funds him — the same shape already rejected on the Nusa leg. Juranović is excluded on his status flag, a textbook case of a healthy-looking average sitting next to a falling value. Burkardt is back on the board at a worse premium than when he was last rejected.

movers.reason: One qualifying listing, and it expires inside the hour. Neuhaus is a market listing rather than a manager ask, priced at exactly his market value, flagged rising and carrying no status problem — the precise shape the doctrine says to bid. Bid exactly his value and do not raise: win it and you capture tonight's update, lose it and it has cost you nothing. The timing leg is satisfied because the auction resolves well before tonight's tick, so a winner owns him when it lands. Be clear-eyed about the odds — his scoring average comes off a single appearance and is not form, and listings with averages that high are the band you win least often, so this is a cheap option rather than a likely win. The transfer check passes: the Gladbach story about pushing him out is from 04.07.2026, he refused to leave, the summer window has since closed, and the winter window is months away — no risk of him leaving the league before this resolves. Buying him does not reduce your fielded eleven, and the unwind holds comfortably even if the tick goes against you. One other listing has the right shape but the wrong clock: Ruoppi qualifies structurally yet does not resolve for another day and a half, so today's rising flag says nothing about the tick he would actually be owned for. He is logged to re-examine, not to bid. The drift table was re-measured from the event log this run and is unchanged on every figure, so there is still no sign of rivals crowding the edge out. Two things remain open and unresolved, as they have been: whether Kickbase caps squad size, which would cap how many flips you can run at once, and the standing caveat that this edge is measured in one league over one period and will decay if the other traders find it.

fitness.sweep: Nothing newly wrong, and both existing flags were re-checked against dated sources rather than carried forward on trust. Gregoritsch picked up a knock on Austria duty on 24.09.2026, the Austrian federation gave the all-clear on 25.09, and by 28.09 he was working individually toward a quick return. Gruber withdrew from international duty on 21.09 with knee irritation, was reported on 22.09 as not in danger of missing the Leverkusen game, and was completing an individual programme on 29.09. Both are knocks rather than injuries, and both have a week and a half before the matchday locks, so neither is a sell trigger — but they are the two bodies to re-check as the lock approaches. Everyone else in the squad is unflagged. The league-wide injury table surfaced nothing against any of your players.
